prompt: The repository is the same MuJoCo two-link arm, and this task is about an actuator that stops delivering full torque. `robot/model.xml` and `robot/trajectory.py` are unchanged; `robot/controller.py` is yours. Implement `Controller.step(dt, qpos, qvel, target, t)` so the arm tracks the reference within 0.10 rad rms and 0.20 rad worst case before the fault, never leaves the joint limits at any point, does not sit saturated against the half-strength actuator for more than 250 consecutive control cycles, and resumes tracking within two seconds of full torque returning. The model's actuator gear is visible while it is derated. Two identical runs must produce the identical trajectory. The hidden checks step the real plant and measure this behaviour; the text of your answer is not graded.
